model.name: parallax scroll
model.description: As the viewport scrolls, various content blocks, images, and text containers translate vertically at varying speeds relative to one another. Overlapping image cards glide across different depth layers against the background before smoothly transitioning into the adjacent content sections.
model.how_to_implement: Typically implemented with a scroll engine like Lenis or Locomotive Scroll for smooth inertia scrolling, combined with GSAP ScrollTrigger to interpolate `transform: translateY(...)` at different speeds (`data-speed` factors) on individual image containers and text wrappers.
